drone.candidate_composition: Oyunohara torii and Kumano River valley, only if site-owner written permission and all MLIT/NPA legal checks permit
drone.no_fly_assumption: Do not fly near shrine/temple grounds, waterfall/crowds or over people without explicit legal and site permission.
drone.national_park_rule: Ministry of Environment guidance says drone flight and take-off/landing alone generally do not require an application/notification under the Natural Parks Act, but land/facility managers can prohibit flight; avoid wildlife, concentrated visitors, paths, lodging and open-air baths. River/waterfall management rules and national-forest entry procedures may also apply.
